snippet.title: SNES Sougou Kakutougi: Astral Bout
snippet.description: The "Astral Bout" trilogy remains a curious entry in the Super Famicom library. Based on Japan's Fighting Network Rings promotion, you can consider this the precursor of today's Mixed Martial Arts tournaments around the world. The game's fighting system is rather unique but once you get the hang of the basics, it's fun. Enjoy some Pro Wrestling from my end of the game.
